items.stem: The Cursor agent made changes across four files, including one unrelated to the task. What should you do before accepting?

options.text: Review the full diff and reject the unrelated change
options.rationale: Correct: reviewing the diff and rejecting out-of-scope edits is the accountable step.

options.text: Accept everything because the agent is usually right
options.rationale: Accepting unreviewed multi-file edits is exactly the risk to avoid.

options.text: Delete the repository and start over
options.rationale: That is disproportionate; the diff can simply be reviewed.

options.text: Disable tests so the change applies faster
options.rationale: Disabling tests removes the check you need.

items.explanation: Correct: reviewing the diff and rejecting out-of-scope edits is the accountable step.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO actions give the Cursor agent better context for a scoped change? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Attach the specific files the change touches
options.rationale: Correct: focused, relevant files improve the agent's results.

options.text: Reference the exact function or symbol to edit
options.rationale: Correct: precise references reduce the chance of editing the wrong code.

options.text: Paste the entire repository into the chat
options.rationale: Dumping everything adds noise and wastes context.

options.text: Give no files and hope it finds them
options.rationale: Leaving context to chance produces unreliable edits.

items.explanation: Correct: focused, relevant files improve the agent's results.

items.stem: Which task is the clearest case for a direct manual edit rather than the agent?

options.text: Renaming one local variable in the file you are looking at
options.rationale: Correct: a trivial local edit is faster to type than to delegate.

options.text: A coordinated change across many files
options.rationale: That is where the agent helps most.

options.text: Adding a feature touching several modules
options.rationale: A multi-step task suits the agent.
Broad changes benefit from agent assistance plus review.

items.explanation: Correct: a trivial local edit is faster to type than to delegate.
